benchmark: Cook (1974) membrane, clamped left edge, unit shear resultant on the right edge, E = 1, nu = 1/3, unit thickness, plane stress
reference_source: Cook (1974) / standard FE benchmark value 23.96 (tip vertical deflection); the value is an external anchor, all computed numbers come from the solver
p_observed_note: observed order on the 16/32/64 sequence, e = |w - 23.96|, p = log2(e32/e64)
note: bilinear Q4 under integrated shear; convergence is monotone from below and sub-quadratic because the exact Cook field is dominated by a boundary layer, so the criterion is scored on the finest mesh and cross-checked by the Richardson extrapolation
